oracle_snapshots.name: Dr. Eggman
oracle_snapshots.text:
Flying
At the beginning of your end step, draw a card. Then each opponent faces a villainous choice — That player discards a card, or you may put a Construct, Robot, or Vehicle card from your hand onto the battlefield.

strategy.primary: Villainous-choice artifact cheat: hold big Constructs, Robots and Vehicles so each opponent either discards or lets you put one onto the battlefield free at your end step; punish discards and multiply Eggman's trigger.
strategy.secondary: Artifact ETB payoffs over cast payoffs (Eggman doesn't cast), Gearhulks and Myr Battlesphere, discard punishers (Liliana's Caress, Waste Not, Tinybones) and The Valeyard/Y'shtola extra choices.

identity.why: End-step draw and the discard-or-deploy fork.
Extra end step: another full Eggman trigger.
Each discard costs 2 life, so the discard branch hurts.
